_comment: Rules for the shared privacy scanner (amajail/dev-kit). The engine is shared;
these rules are not, because what counts as private differs per repo.
This repo tracks a real investment portfolio and must be treated as public.
Deliberately no real symbol, quantity or PPC appears below — the patterns
describe the SHAPE and the LOCATION of private data, never an instance of it.
privatePaths: the positions seed file, which carries real quantities and PPC
a local-only script or config, written against the live portfolio
an ad-hoc bulk-update script, which names real positions
an owner-private document — ignored wholesale, so a new one is safe the moment it exists
a rendered portfolio report, with real totals and P&L
a rendered rebalance plan naming the real brokers and amounts
the rebalance metaprompt, which embeds the real portfolio
a screenshot or snapshot of the running dashboard, which captures real totals
the owner's real ticker list, which is itself a holdings disclosure
machine-specific notes — real resource names and local paths
_privatePathExceptionsWhy: Both are denied by the BUILT-IN `.env` rule, and a rule's own `unless` cannot
reach a default — hence this list rather than an `unless`. `.env.test` holds
Azurite placeholders that the CI test run needs; dashboard/.env.production is
the public dashboard URL. Both are un-ignored in .gitignore for the same reason.
_secretPatternsWhy: Almost everything this repo needs is already a dev-kit default. Only the two
shapes whose local versions were case-insensitive are restated here. The old
dev-kit narrowed it to a quoted literal containing `;` because the broad form
flagged ordinary save/restore code — and it would flag .env.test's
_privateTermsFileWhy: Gitignored on purpose: a committed list of the owner's real tickers is itself a holdings disclosure. Consequence — CI can never run this check, only the local hook can.
_selfExemptWhy: This file necessarily contains the credential shapes it looks for. Exempt from CONTENT rules only — never from path rules.

wording.boundary: real holdings, credentials and owner-private docs
wording.confirm: real quantities, PPC/averageCost, prices, or account identifiers
wording.fixHint:
Docs with real figures belong in docs/private/ (gitignored), never elsewhere.
  If this block is wrong, run /claude-md-fix so the rule gets fixed, not worked around.
